title: The Quiet Postcards
author: Wren Quintana
blurb: Cyrus Eriksen, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
